title: Browser canary for configurable Habits trackers
mission: Run the isolated configurable-Habits candidate in a representative JavaScript browser without changing Current, Human Accepted or Served. Exercise add, rename, classification, archive, restore and reload with IndexedDB available, then exercise the durable local fallback with IndexedDB unavailable or intentionally blocked. Confirm Calendar and Money remain behaviorally intact and a new profile receives no mandatory personal tracker labels.
definition_of_done: The isolated candidate loads in a representative JavaScript browser without changing Current, Human Accepted or Served pointers.
Add, rename, classification, archive, restore and reload are verified with IndexedDB available.
Reload persistence is verified through the durable local fallback with IndexedDB unavailable or intentionally blocked.
Calendar and Money surfaces remain behaviorally intact.
A genuinely new profile is not seeded with mandatory personal/sensitive tracker labels.
Exact browser evidence and observation time are persisted.
